description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Cancellation of a Licence Issued to Swarnamahal Financial Services PLC
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the cancellation of a finance business license for a specific company (Swarnamahal Financial Services PLC) under the Finance Business Act. This falls under commercial matters related to business licensing and financial institution regulations, which is the definition of Type 6 (Commercial Gazettes). While it involves the Central Bank Governor, the content focuses on regulatory action against a commercial entity rather than government personnel or structural changes.
